answer: An economy of agents trading jetty access, reef surveys and voyage insurance can weight governance votes by tokens locked for 30 days, rather than by account count. Splitting 100 locked tokens among a thousand identities still yields only 100 votes, since each token can back just one ballot per proposal. To gain majority control, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more voting stake than all honest participants combined, tying up capital and bearing token price risk.
